description: U+FEFF incidental (1), write route variable: DAO Database.Execute (dbFailOnError) of INSERT statements with the string as a SQL literal, ACCDB. Table W(ID LONG key, T TEXT(255), M MEMO) holds values ID 1 feff, ID 2 lead-ascii, ID 3 trail-ascii, ID 4 inner, ID 5 lead-euro, ID 6 lead-latin1, ID 7 double, ID 8 feff-fffe, ID 9 fffe-lead, ID 10 plain, ID 11 lead-long (lead-long is U+FEFF then 100 x; double is two U+FEFF; feff-fffe is U+FEFF U+FFFE; fffe-lead is U+FFFE ab). After closing, the table is read twice: a DAO snapshot of ID, T, M, Len, AscW of positions 1-3 of T and 1-2 of M, and an ADO recordset of ID, T, M, Len(T), Len(M). Asks which positions of a U+FEFF are lost, whether write route or read route changes it, and whether the loss is at write (all routes agree) or read.
